From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Burst pocket onramp & commit uplift

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Per our call, here’s a compact proposal to get EdgeRetail comfortable with a higher hosted API commit while preserving predictable unit economics and a short-term burst pocket for holiday spikes. I attached a one-page draft master amendment and a usage scaffold that models monthly trajectory.

High-level proposal (starter):
- Increase monthly committed tokens from 6M -> 15M (12-month term) with a 20% step-down discount band after month 9 if monthly usage drifts below commit floor.
- Add a 10% burst pocket over commit for seasonal peaks (billed at a discounted overage rate vs on-demand). Burst is throttled by bandwidth gating to preserve latency SLOs.
- Soft throttle policy: 95th percentile latency target maintained; if throughput exceeds the burst ceiling for >6 hours, automatic fallback to a compatible quantized model (same quality profile) for overflow.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick pricing confirmation from our pricing ops (Karthik) — can you confirm list vs committed unit economics?
2) Sign a short MA addendum to lock the commit and burst pocket for Nov–Oct 2027.
3) 30-minute alignment call to review PO and DocuSign timeline.

I’m available Wed 11/12 10–12 PT or Thu 11/13 14–16 PT.

Attachments: Draft_MA_BurstOnramp_v1.pdf, Usage_Scaffold.xlsx

—
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Priya / Emma — attaching the pricing options as discussed. TL;DR: committed pricing (15M/mo) yields a 28% discount vs current hosted list at your 10M steady run-rate; at full 15M commit the effective discount is 35%. Burst is priced at a predictable 40% uplift over committed unit (capped to 10% of monthly tokens) — that beats our standard on-demand delta which can vary between 60–80% depending on peak.

Key bullets for procurement:
- Committed line: 15,000,000 tokens/mo — effective unit cost = $0.0009 @ 10M steady (month-to-month blended), $0.00075 @ 15M fill.
- Burst pocket: up to +10% tokens at $0.00126 per token (40% over committed rate), monthly cap enforced; excess beyond burst routed to on-demand and billed at standard on-demand.
- Billing: monthly invoice with line items (commit, burst usage, overage).
- PO/DocuSign: we will provide a PO-ready PDF and a DocuSign envelope link within 24 hours of sign-off on these pricing bullets.

Attachments: pricing-options.csv

Happy to hop on Thu 15:00 PT and walk procurement through the billing lines.
